subject: Security questionnaire: hosted API — data residency, retention & deletion
messages:
From: Amelia Ortiz <amelia.ortiz@globobank.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security questionnaire: data handling for hosted API

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this — GloboBank's procurement/security teams have a short questionnaire focused on data residency, retention, and deletion for any hosted LLM APIs we evaluate. Can you confirm the following for Redwood's hosted API (short answers are fine; we'll follow up where needed):

1) Where is customer request/response data stored by default (region/locations)?
2) What is the default retention period for request/response payloads and derived artifacts (embeddings, reranks)?
3) Do you use customer content to train models or improve weights by default?
4) What is the process and timeline for a customer-initiated deletion request (primary store + backups/snapshots)?
5) How do you handle logs and audit records that may contain customer identifiers? Retention and redaction policy?
6) Are there controls to restrict data to a specific physical jurisdiction (EU/US-only)?
7) Is all hosted data encrypted at rest and in transit? Key management options?
8) Can you provide a sample audit-log export and a SOC2 artifact?

I've attached our questionnaire as an xlsx for reference. If a short call is easier, we can do 30 minutes today.

Best,
Amelia
Security Procurement — GloboBank
Attachment: GloboBank_SecQ_2027.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Ortiz <amelia.ortiz@globobank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire: data handling for hosted API

Hi Amelia — thanks for sending this over. Below are concise answers to each item; I've also attached a short policy PDF and our deletion API spec for your legal/procurement team. Happy to jump on a quick call if you'd like deeper detail.

Q1 — Default storage locations:
- By default, customer request and response data for Redwood Hosted API is stored in the regional cloud region nearest the request origin (US central and EU-west regions available). For standard accounts created in the US we store data in our US region (primary: us-west-2).

Q2 — Default retention windows:
- Request/response payloads (raw text & generated outputs): retained for 30 days by default.
- Derived artifacts (embeddings, reranking indices): retained for 90 days by default unless explicitly configured otherwise.
- Short-lived model inference caches (KV caches) are ephemeral and not persisted beyond the inference lifecycle.

Q3 — Use of customer content for model training:
- Redwood does not use customer request/response data to train or improve model weights for hosted API customers without explicit, written consent. We offer an opt-in program for telemetry/aggregate usage collection for customers who want to participate; that program is separate and documented.

Q4 — Deletion process & timeline:
- Customer-initiated deletion (via console or support ticket): primary data removed from the live store within 7 business days.
- Backups & snapshots: best-effort purge from backups/snapshots within 90 days; some immutable backup systems may have retention windows up to 90 days. We document exact timelines in the contract for Dedicated/Enterprise.
- We provide a deletion API (see attached Deletion_API_Spec.md) and a support-assisted purge flow for account closures.

Q5 — Logs & audit records:
- Access/audit logs are retained for 90 days by default and include request metadata (timestamps, request IDs, model used, token counts).
- We redact or truncate fields that may contain full customer payloads in logs by default; raw payloads are separated and subject to the retention rules above.
- Longer retention and archival of logs is available as an add-on.

Q6 — Jurisdictional controls:
- We support region pinning for Enterprise (EU-only, US-only) so data never leaves the selected jurisdiction. Self-hosted/Private and Dedicated deployments provide stronger guarantees (VPC/on-prem and isolated GPU pools).

Q7 — Encryption & key management:
- All hosted data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256).
- Default keys are managed by our cloud provider; enterprise customers can bring keys via KMS integrations (BYOK) and HSM options for Private deployments.

Q8 — Audit exports & SOC2:
- We can produce a sample audit-log export (CSV) and provide a SOC2 summary report (attestation) under NDA. I've attached a SOC2-summary (redacted) and will provide a CSV sample on request.

Next steps: if you want the sample audit log + a redacted SOC2 file, I can send both to the email on your questionnaire and we can schedule a 30-minute review with Rishi (security) and Ben (sales).

Regards,

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-05-18T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire: data handling for hosted API

Hi Stephanie — thanks, that is helpful. A few quick clarifications before procurement moves this to the legal queue:

- Can you confirm the 90-day backup purge window is a hard maximum for hosted customers (i.e., we should expect up to 90 days for complete removal from all offline snapshots)?
- For the audit export, can you provide a sample that includes the schema (field names) but redacted payloads? That helps our SIEM/integration team validate mapping.
- Please confirm that the default 30-day payload retention applies to both inputs and generated outputs (we call these PII candidates).

If you can send the CSV + SOC2 summary and a short note confirming the backup window and the definition of "payloads" we'll be able to mark this as reviewed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Amelia

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Ortiz <amelia.ortiz@globobank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire: data handling for hosted API

Amelia — thanks for the follow-up. Confirmations and next artifacts below.

- Backup purge window: confirmed — for Redwood Hosted API the maximum purge window from all backups/snapshots is 90 days for standard hosted accounts. For Enterprise/Dedicated contracts we can negotiate shorter contractual windows and provide stricter deletion SLAs.

- Payload definition & 30-day retention: by "payloads" we mean full request inputs and generated outputs (the raw text sent and the model-generated response). Those are retained 30 days by default; metadata (request id, timestamps, token counts) follows the log retention policy (90 days).

- Attached now:
  * audit-log-sample-2027.csv — schema present, payload columns redacted (REDACTED).
  * SOC2-summary-Redwood-2026.pdf — redacted copy for procurement.

I've also opened ticket #9271 in our support portal with the request to produce a formal export if you need a signed evidence package. If GloboBank requires a tighter retention contractually, we can produce an addendum for the Dedicated/Enterprise offering.

If you'd like, Rishi can join a short call to walk GloboBank's security team through the audit CSV schema and redaction approach — otherwise we can exchange notes over email.

Thanks — will await confirmation that these artifacts are sufficient.

Regards,
Stephanie
